text:
emma: :rotating_light: ACME (customer) reports severe p99 regressions for embeddings in apac region and intermittent 401s since last-night driver+cuda rollout. They see 2-3x tail latency and some requests failing with `401 auth error` after retries. attaching their screenshots/traces.

sam_oncall: thanks, Emma — paging eng-runtime + eng-infra. can you dump the customer's trace ids and the approximate time window? I'll start triage channel.

emma: trace ids: acme-emb-2026-03-17T01:12Z (several). window ~ 2026-03-17T01:10-01:25 UTC. repro steps from customer: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"open-embed-4","input":"<large-batch>"}'` (their batch sizes are larger than usual). They also said they saw `nvidia: driver rm error` in host logs.

vikram: looking at metrics — prom query `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embeddings",region="apac"}[5m])) by (le))` shows p99 jump from ~180ms to ~600ms at 01:11 UTC. Errors (4xx) spike at same time. Could be GPU preemption or NVMe host IO queuing after driver update.

lina: on infra side I see a correlated NVMe qdepth spike on apac nodes: `node=apac-gpu-17` qdepth increased ~5x at 01:10. dmesg on that host shows repeated timeouts followed by driver reset: `NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus` then `nvidia_uvm: GPU reset completed`.

emma: customer noted it sometimes recovers after ~30s, then gets 401s during the window. guessing token refresh loops when embeddings RPCs stall and backend auth times out.

vikram: quick repro I ran (small synthetic): `ab -n 200 -c 8 -p large_payload.json -T application/json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` against apac edge shows tail spikes when request batching coalesces. suspect interaction between driver resets and our request batching/KV-cache code causing transient auth refreshes.

jess: I'm on stand with ACME. They want ETA for mitigation. For immediate workarounds they asked if we can route embeddings for their org to eu fallback or reduce concurrency. Can we do that quickly?

sam_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) create temporary routing rule for ACME to eu1 embeddings cluster (reduce latency penalty, avoid apac nodes). 2) add circuit-breaker to reject oversized batches in apac for now. 3) eng-infra to verify driver/firmware and prepare rollback candidate. 4) eng-runtime to add short-term fallback in routing and mark this a P1.

lina: infra action: capturing host artifacts (dmesg, /var/log/messages, nvidia-smi -q, smartctl) for affected nodes. i've scheduled a rollback window but need eng signoff. provisional root suspect: driver+firmware combination -> NVMe queue saturation + GPU resets. will attach artifacts to the ticket.

vikram: runtime action: throttling batch coalescing for apac (reduce max batch size from 128->64 and lower max latency target) will be deployed as hotfix in next 10m. also adding guard to pause auth refresh if request in-flight > 15s to avoid cascading 401s.

emma: ACME agreed to routing to eu fallback for now. Jess will coordinate. I'm updating the customer with the temporary mitigations and ETA ~15-30m for routing and hotfix.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0034. Alerts muted for apac embeddings for next 30m while mitigation is in-flight.

sam_oncall: good. please add all artifacts and a clear rollback plan to the incident. eng-runtime/eng-infra, after hotfix and rollback decision let's do controlled canary (2 nodes) before full rollback. assign follow-ups in the incident doc.

emma: copying summary to the incident notes. will add ACME contact, traces, repro commands, and screenshots.

vikram: noted — after we stabilize we'll run a controlled repro with telemetry (nvlink/link dumps, iostat, pending IO qdepth). plan for post-mortem: reproduce with driver combination in staging, test kernel preempt settings and cgroup blkio limits. also consider adding a graceful-kill on GPU reset to avoid auth storm.

jess: ACME is ok with canary route + rollback if needed. they flagged this as customer-impacting; I'll keep them updated every 30m.

sam_oncall: thanks team. I'll keep this thread pinned to the incident. escalate if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
